mapper.select: select task_id, task_name, status from analysis_task where task_id = #{taskId} for update
select * from ontology_analysis_job where task_id = #{taskId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into ontology_analysis_job (task_id, run_token, status, stage, request_json, checkpoint_json, username, message, lease_until, model_calls, created_at, updated_at) values (#{taskId}, #{runToken}, 'RUNNING', #{stage}, #{requestJson}, #{checkpointJson}, #{username}, #{message}, #{leaseUntil}, 0, current_timestamp, current_timestamp)
mapper.update: update ontology_analysis_job set run_token = #{runToken}, status = 'RUNNING', stage = #{stage}, request_json = #{requestJson}, checkpoint_json = #{checkpointJson}, username = #{username}, message = #{message}, lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, model_calls = 0, proposal_id = null, updated_at = current_timestamp where task_id = #{taskId}

update ontology_analysis_job set status = #{status}, message = #{message}, proposal_id = #{proposalId}, updated_at = current_timestamp where task_id = #{taskId} and run_token = #{runToken} and status = 'RUNNING'
update analysis_task set status = #{status}, summary = #{message}, update_by = #{username}, update_time = current_timestamp where task_id = #{taskId}
